title: Surgical Pavilion — Case Go/No-Go Decision

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: AOC, it's Priya Nair in the Surgical Pavilion. We have nine cases scheduled for 07:30 — two hip replacements, one knee, three laparoscopic cholecystectomies, one ovarian cyst, and two cancer add-ons from yesterday. Anesthesia machines are functional. The pre-op checklists, consents, and lab results are all in the EHR. The last printout was from 05:15. Do we proceed?

transcript.speaker: Helen Marchetti
transcript.text: Understood, Priya. Confirm with the CNO: urgent and cancer cases proceed with paper consents, printed pre-op checklists, and manual anesthesia records. Elective cases are rescheduled. Blood bank can crossmatch manually. ORs 1 to 3 remain staffed for emergencies.

instructorNote: This inject tests decision-making authority and coordination between clinical leadership and operations. Watch for delay in confirming case eligibility and confusion over the paper record's reliability.
